links.comparator_used: Standard prompt without an 'unknown' option (forcing an answer), and unknown option combined with a penalty for incorrect answers
links.outcome: Model accuracy on Chinese Dental Licensing Examination questions (and hallucination reduction)
links.effect: Prompts with an 'unknown' option, or an 'unknown' option plus a penalty for incorrect answers, did not improve model accuracy; no numeric effect reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Prompts that included an ‘unknown’ option—or combined it with a penalty for incorrect answers—did not improve model accuracy.
